counter.description: Schedule execution counter, including zero for an initial full differential result.

decorations.description: JSON representation of native logger decorations, without treating arbitrary keys as hostnames or MISP tags.

epoch.description: Original schedule epoch marker, not a timestamp or process identity.

execution-time.description: Query execution/log time normalized from native unixTime seconds or an explicit collector timestamp; not entity creation/deletion time.

execution-time-raw.description: Original collector execution timestamp when provided outside native logger metadata.

host-identifier.description: Host identifier from osquery or explicit collector context. It may be a UUID/custom value and is not assumed to be a hostname.

numerics.description: Explicit native numerics flag; raw column values retain their original JSON types.

osquery-version.description: Producer-supplied osquery version; never inferred from the importer environment.

pack-name.description: Pack identity supplied by the producer or unambiguously recovered from a MISP-generated scheduled name.

query-name.description: Query identity, stripped of a pack prefix only with explicit pack context or an unambiguous MISP-generated query suffix.

record-context.description: Normalized source log metadata excluding columns/snapshot/diffResults payloads. Original attached bytes remain authoritative.

record-index.description: One-based source log-record ordinal, excluding blank JSONL lines.

record-type.description: row for a real returned row, or empty-result for an explicitly empty snapshot/batch. Empty-result is not a matched finding.

result-kind.description: snapshot or differential; does not establish maliciousness or remediation.

review-status.description: Imported observations start as unreviewed. A query result alone does not confirm malicious activity.

row.description: Normalized JSON of the exact returned columns, retaining unknown fields and numeric/string types.

row-action.description: Native row action: snapshot, added or removed. A removed row does not delete MISP data or prove remediation.

row-count.description: Number of returned rows carried by this source log record, including zero for an explicit empty result; an event-format record does not report the total query row count.

row-index.description: One-based row ordinal within the expansion of that source record; omitted for empty results.

scheduled-name.description: Exact native scheduled-query name, including the full pack prefix when supplied.

source-indicators.description: JSON array of original event/object/attribute references from the hunting exporter sources map. These are contextual references, not imported IDS attributes or verification of a match.

source-sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact imported result export bytes.

unix-time.description: Original osquery unixTime value, defined as Unix seconds. Never infer units from magnitude.

description: An osquery snapshot or differential result with host, query/pack, execution and source-indicator provenance. Empty results and removed rows retain their distinct meanings and do not imply a malicious verdict.
name: osquery-result
